entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Sarah at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I have a VeloBand Pulse and I think I need to return it. I'm not really sure how this all works, it's a bit overwhelming.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh no, it works perfectly. It was a bit of an impulse buy, to be honest. I just changed my mind about the whole fitness tracking thing. I just... I don't use it, and I feel bad having it sit here.
I see. Thank you for clarifying that for me. Let me pull up your account. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 16th, so about 18 days ago. Is that correct?

I guess? The dates are confusing. I was looking on the website... I thought I read something about having to try resale or a marketplace if you waited too long. The policy seemed really complicated. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to make this easy for you. Let me just double-check our official return policy in my system. One moment please.
Okay, I've got it pulled up. Our knowledge base confirms that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they are in their original condition.
Wait, 90 days? Really? I must have been reading something else. That's... a relief.
Yes, absolutely. Since you're only on day 18, you're well within that 90-day window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you and email you a pre-paid shipping label right now.
Oh, wow. Yes, please! That would be perfect. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried this would be a problem.

It's my pleasure to help. I have just sent that email. Please follow the instructions to package the VeloBand Pulse and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in about 5-7 business days. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
